svg.title: Truck Parking Daily Rates by Market Density
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-07-truck-parking-daily-rate-bands; chapter number: 4; title: Truck Parking Daily Rates by Market Density; subtitle: No-ownership parking arbitrage priced per truck per day; caption: Evan Shealy prices Truck Parking Club lots at $10-$15 rural, $20-$25 suburban and $30-plus in dense markets, averaging about $20 a day.; assumptions note: Bands are Evan Shealy's. The dense-market band has no stated ceiling, so $30 marks its floor only. Lots must sit on gravel, asphalt millings or compacted ground, away from active retail and residential.; note: Source: Ask Flip Man, Evan Shealy (NIYpBpIvXTc @ 00:14:17, 00:07:16).; chart type: stacked_comparison; total range: $10 to $30-plus per truck per day; buckets: label: Rural Lot; low: 10; high: 15; notes: Lowest band on the platform.; label: Suburban Lot; low: 20; high: 25; notes: Mid band for suburban locations.; label: Dense Metro Lot; low: 30; high: 30; notes: $30-plus in LA-Long Beach, Dallas, Chicago, New York-Newark and Orlando.; label: Platform Average; low: 20; high: 20; notes: About $20 per truck per day across listed lots.
